description: Defines a Flutter widget for a payment method selection bottom sheet, providing quick access to payment apps via deep links and handling app not installed scenarios.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a bottom sheet with payment options for Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Creates a list tile for a payment option with icon, name, color, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch the specified payment app URI; shows a message if the app is not installed.
